Devin —

Really appreciate the clear forecast — that helps a lot. We'd love to run this pilot with CognexHealth. Standard pilot program gives up to a 20% usage discount for short-term evaluations; anything deeper requires executive sign-off because it materially impacts unit economics.

Short ask: can you share expected monthly spend $ range and procurement timeline (PO/contract window)? If you can commit to a 6-month pilot with the usage forecast you sent, I will escalate for approval of a deeper concession; my initial internal read is we can consider a 25%–30% discount for 6 months with some commercial conditions (commit to a post-pilot renewal window or staged usage commitments).

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing and pilot terms — request for exec clearance (RDW-54731)

Folks — forwarding Devin's request and the usage forecast. Key points:
- Account: CognexHealth (strategic healthcare prospect)
- Forecast: ~120M tokens/month initial; potential for >300M within 9–12 months if pilot meets SLA
- Ask: 35% discount for a 6-month, month-to-month pilot (Procurement needs flexibility)

Options I propose for sign-off (ranked):
1) Approve 25% discount for 6 months + automatic discussion for renewal at month 5; require PoC KPI gates (latency < 250ms p95, summary F1 delta within 1.5% of baseline) — low revenue hit, keeps economics manageable.
2) Approve 30% discount for 6 months if Cognex commits to a 12-month renewal at a 15% discount floor after pilot (reduce downside risk).
3) Approve 35% (what they asked) only with a minimum committed spend/retainer or multi-region activation clause — prefer not to unless exec greenlight.

Attached is a quick quote (v2) drafted for the pilot. Deal ID RDW-54731. I'm asking for explicit authorization to offer above 20%. Jonas — could you weight in on acceptable finance guardrails? Mina/Marissa — need final exec sign-off for any >20% concession.

Attachments: Cognex_Quote_v2.pdf (quote)

Thanks — Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing and pilot terms — request for exec clearance (RDW-54731)

Ben / team —

Reviewed the background and the options. CognexHealth is strategically important for our healthcare GTM and the ramp profile looks credible given the clinical use-case. Approve option 2 with the following firm conditions:

1) Offer 30% discount on Hosted API usage for a 6-month pilot (effective immediately upon SOW signature).
2) Require a signed Letter of Intent (LOI) or SOW that includes a post-pilot commitment: Cognex will enter a 12-month renewal at a minimum 15% discount floor or a guaranteed minimum total spend (whichever is higher). Exact floor TBD with Finance.
3) Pilot gates: define KPIs (latency p95 < 250ms, summary quality baseline within 2%). Legal to include standard liability limits.
4) Finance (Jonas) to confirm impact and record concession in Deal Desk tracking sheet; procurement credit/credit note must be preapproved.

Mina — please flag any contract/legal concerns. Jonas — please confirm if 30% (with the renewal floor) is acceptable from a finance exposure viewpoint; if yes, Ben, you have greenlight to present the 30% pilot rate to Cognex and move contract forward.

I'll sign off on an exception memo after Jonas posts the finance note.

—Marissa

Devin — great news. We received executive approval to support a deeper pilot concession. Summary of approved terms:

- Pilot gates: p95 latency < 250ms; summary quality within 2% of the baseline model.
- Legal/PO: we'll share a SOW/LOI. Please loop in procurement so we can finalize contract language and any PO requirements.
